head: mi-169-cancel-blocked-wrong-order-id
title: MI-169: HALT — the approved cancel names order 548, which is in oca-protect-t5353, not t5531
body:
## Nothing was cancelled. No journal row was written.

I was dispatched to execute the operator-approved Option 3 of MI-167 — cancel the two legs of `oca-protect-t5531`, then repair trade 5531's journal row. **I did neither, because the approved action's order ids do not match the venue.**

### The blocking finding

The dispatch named the legs as order **548** (STP 43 @ 4394.5) and **551** (LMT 43 @ 4485.0). Verified live against `/api/diag/ib_open_orders?account_id=ib_paper` — `read_state: "orders_read"`, three byte-identical reads at 19:30:54Z / :55Z / :56Z:

| order | type | qty | price | oca_group |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **548** | STP | **11** | 4210.7 | **`oca-protect-t5353`** |
| 549 | LMT | 11 | 4807.5 | `oca-protect-t5353` |
| **550** | STP | **43** | **4394.5** | **`oca-protect-t5531`** |
| **551** | LMT | **43** | **4485.0** | **`oca-protect-t5531`** |

**No order 548 with shape `STP 43 @ 4394.5` exists.** That shape is order **550**. Order 548 is the resting 11-lot stop of `oca-protect-t5353` — the group the dispatch explicitly forbade touching, protecting trade 5353's real 11-lot position. The journal corroborates independently: row 5353's `stop_loss` is 4210.70714286 (= order 548); row 5531's is 4394.47142857 (= order 550).

Cancelling as instructed would have **stripped a real position's protection while leaving the 43-lot hazard resting** — reproducing `BL-20260820-OVERCOVER-REMEDIATION-CANCELLED-THE-JOURNAL-MATCHING-LEG`.

### Where the error comes from

Not a manager typo. MI-167's timeline is correct (`548/549 -> t5353`, `550/551 -> t5531`), but its **operator-decision block** writes the option as *"Cancel `oca-protect-t5531`'s two legs (548->551 group)"*. That shorthand contradicts the document's own table and propagated into the operator approval. **The operator approved a correctly-named group with a wrongly-named pair of ids.**

### Why I stopped rather than resolving the group to 550/551

The group name is unambiguous and I could have acted on intent. I did not, because this is Tier-3 on the order path; the id that is wrong points precisely at the forbidden group; and there is **no clock** — `ib_paper` is paper money and the `sl_cross` verdict has been `None (no action)` since 11:45Z. The dispatch's own gate says stop and report if the ids cannot be re-identified. Re-confirming against corrected ids is the same decision, correctly addressed.

I also did **not** do the journal repair alone — the approved order is cancel-then-repair, and a repair alone leaves 43 resting sell lots.

### PnL, re-derived rather than copied

MGC multiplier **10** (10 troy oz/contract). IB does not rewrite `avgCost` on a reduction, so entry comes from the book delta:

```
entry(43) = (54 x 4423.021925925 - 11 x 4386.00509091) / 43 = 4432.491348835...
PnL       = 43 x (4392.9 - 4432.491349) x 10 = -$17,024.28
```

Reproduces MI-167 exactly. **Verified and ready to write — not written.**

### Also reported

- ⚠️ The first `ib_open_orders` read of this session returned **`read_state: "could_not_look"`** with `orders: null`. Reported as its own row, not folded into the successful reads.
- ⚠️ `restart_pending` is now **`true`** (`40ebd40b` running, `054650e3` on disk); MI-167 had it false.
- **Root cause remains open under MI-168** — the symbol-scoped close confirmation at `ib_client.py:2636`. A repaired row with the defect live will recur.
- `ict_scalp_mgc_15m`'s aggregates are **still FABRICATED** (the repair did not happen). Not recomputed here.
- Provenance: exit price is broker truth -> `MEASURED` / `exchange_fill`. But `provenance.py` has **no source expressing "session repair"**, so a repaired row would be indistinguishable from a correctly-booked one. Flagged as a real gap; I did not invent a source string.

### Population

One OCA pair on `ib_paper`/MGC. I did **not** sweep for a second instance — that is *"I did not look"*, not *"I looked and found none"*.
